thread:
Zoe P: meet Nimbus, our slightly dramatic rescue bun. he discovered the hallway mirror and now insists on a photoshoot every 15 minutes. photos: https://files.redwood.com/zoe/nimbus-1.jpg , https://files.redwood.com/zoe/nimbus-2.jpg :rabbit: :camera_with_flash:
Ravi N: fashion icon. that ear tilt is peak runway 60d
Tess H: putting Nimbus as my next meeting background. brb making a collage.
Zoe P: collage command I used (imagemagick):
```bash
montage -geometry 400x400 +tile Nimbus-*.jpg nimbus-collage.jpg
```
Miguel A: official poll: should Nimbus get a LinkedIn profile? :thinking_face: :ballot_box_with_ballot:
Ravi N: yes. headline: "Senior Snuggler, Plant Supervisor" :trophy:
ops-bot: reminder: please avoid feeding houseplants to pets. see Animal Care guide in #help :leafy_green:
Tess H: caption suggestion: "if you need me Im on the fern beat" :joy: :herb:
Zoe P: saving for Friday morale drop. feel free to steal the collage for your wallpapers. Nimbus demands applause. :clap:
